Hello chaseEdgeAI, NZ is batting first now,  

"Analyze the IND vs NZ match using the saved data, ID <7a614754-d3c7-4690-b8b2-2759ff00a673>." 
I'll read those files and give the ChaseEdge output: projected totals, winner, over/under and confidence.

streamlit run .\dashboard\app.py - refresh page to see a new data


node --env-file=.env .\dashboard\pollMatch.js --id 7a614754-d3c7-4690-b8b2-2759ff00a673 --interval 30

Then open http://localhost:8501 and choose the match in the sidebar.

Things to know

Refresh: the dashboard only reads saved files and doesn't refresh itself. Press R in the browser, or use the Rerun option, after each poll.
Batting first: the feed doesn't say who batted first, so confirm the Team batting first setting in the sidebar.
10-over and 15-over benchmarks: the poller only records these when it sees the score within about one over after the 10th or 15th over. If the match is already past those points, the benchmark samples will be missing. Tick the benchmark boxes in the sidebar and enter the 10-over and 15-over scores by hand, or the app falls back to the lower-confidence current-match-state estimate.
Fixture date: the fixture I saw earlier was listed as starting Oct 27. If the --list output doesn't show a live match, the feed may not have flagged it live yet. Rerun --list and check that ms shows live.
